newsitem.title: FRANCE: Havas Adv 1997 sales better than forecast.
newsitem.headline: Havas Adv 1997 sales better than forecast.

text.p: Havas Advertising is experiencing turnover growth above its forecasts, Jean-Michel Carlo, vice chairman of the French advertising group, told Reuters on Tuesday.

He said in an interview at the International Advertising Festival here that Havas Advertising Worldwide had shown turnover growth of nine percent by the end of May, whereas the company had set a goal of 5.5 percent.
Profit was also up, he said, but declined to give a figure.

"For Euro RSCG, which makes two thirds of our turnover, we are seeing a rise of 15 percent worldwide against an objective of nine percent, and in France we have risen nine percent although we expected growth of 1.2 percent," he said.
He said the group, a subsidiary of France's Havas, was "reasonably optimistic" on its own activity this year and on the advertising market in general.
"All our agencies are above forecast," he said.
